product_structure_summary._note: High-level map of Third System's offering structure. The detailed specs for each product live in the 'documents' block below. This summary is the navigation layer.

layer_1_public_research.purpose: Free, citable artifacts that establish Third System as a known research practice. Generate inbound flow that feeds Layer 3.
layer_1_public_research.audience: CMOs, brand strategists, journalists, academic peers, prospective clients
layer_1_public_research.commercial_role: No transaction. Builds authority and credibility.

layer_2_methodology_and_frameworks.purpose: Free intellectual property published openly to establish that the measurement is rigorous and peer-reviewable.
products: tri_system_book_and_paper (separate spec — not in this file)
layer_2_methodology_and_frameworks.audience: Academic peers, clients evaluating credibility, journalists fact-checking findings

layer_3_commercial_diagnostics.purpose: Paid client engagements. The only revenue layer currently active.
layer_3_commercial_diagnostics.audience: Paying clients (CMO, brand director, head of brand strategy)
layer_3_commercial_diagnostics.commercial_role: Generates revenue. Pricing per AI Brand Visibility Diagnostic Pilot: $10–15K initial, $20–30K post-validation, $40K+ later.

product_to_template_map._note: Each product maps to one InDesign template family. Products marked 'NOT InDesign' use other design tools (slides, book interior).

template_family_purposes.A-Snapshot: Single-page or 2-page communication. Front (1-col or 2-col) + Back layouts. Use for scan-and-share artifacts where the reader makes a quick engage/move-on decision.
template_family_purposes.B-Snapshot: The back side of A-Snapshot. Used in pair with A-Snapshot; not a standalone product family.
template_family_purposes.C-Brochure: Multi-page long-form report. Cover + body spreads. The flagship template family for any substantive publication. Most Third System reports use this.
template_family_purposes.E-Tri-fold: Single Letter sheet folded into 6 panels. Foldable physical artifact, suited to authority pieces designed for in-person distribution (conferences, SVA, client meetings).
template_family_purposes.0-Cover: Standalone cover treatments. Usable when a deliverable needs only a cover (rare). Not mapped to any current Third System product.
template_family_purposes._unused_families: The InDesign template includes additional master families (D-, F-, G- variants) not currently mapped to any Third System product. Don't introduce these until a product genuinely requires them — a smaller, intentionally-used template set is stronger than every possible layout half-used.

persona_logic._note: The InDesign template uses 'persona' to denote audience-tier variants of the same physical layout: Executive, Manager, Specialist. Third System maps these as follows.

executive_persona.tone: C-suite. Strategic implications first; methodological detail second.

manager_persona.tone: Operational. Clear findings, shareable up and across, light on theoretical framing.
manager_persona.default_body_master: A-Snapshot - Front - 2 Columns - Letter - Portrait + B-Snapshot - Back - Letter - Portrait

specialist_persona.tone: Technical. Methodology, registry construction, statistical caveats foregrounded.

production_sprint_sequence._note: Recommended build order. Not the same as production_priority_order below — that's a flat list. This is sprint-grouped so visual decisions cascade correctly.

sprint_1_foundation_visual_system.rationale: Sets the look. Every later product inherits the visual decisions made here. Build cross_category_report first; it carries the most weight.

products: category_snapshot (one per published category, ~5 to start)
sprint_2_outreach_material.rationale: Lets Pablo start conversations. Strategy doc Week 3 calls for outreach — these are the artifacts that get attached to those messages.

sprint_3_authority_artifact.rationale: Establishes peer-reviewable credibility. Distributable at SVA, conferences, in client evaluation conversations.

sprint_4_commercial_enablement.rationale: Built once a paid pilot is in conversation. Anonymized version of the client deliverable, sent when prospects ask 'what does the deliverable look like?'

sprint_5_sales_tool_when_warranted.rationale: Don't build until you have warm leads. Shape becomes clear from what prospects actually ask about.

deferred_until_triggered.rationale: Each has a specific trigger condition. Don't pre-build.

cross_category_report.status: REDESIGN — source content exists at v06_source_text.md (extracted from report_v0_6_cross.pdf)
cross_category_report.name: Cross-Category Findings
cross_category_report.subtitle_pattern: AI Presence Index v{version} across {N} Categories
cross_category_report.purpose: Flagship publication. Sets the visual system that every other deliverable inherits. Demonstrates pattern replication across categories.
cross_category_report.audience: CMOs, brand strategists, researchers, journalists, prospective clients.
cross_category_report.preferred_master: C-Brochure - Cover - Option 1 - Letter (cover) + C-Brochure - Product - AB - Letter (body)
structure: Cover: title, version, date, byline_short, primary tagline, Third System / AI Presence Index lockup
Lead spread: 'For the first time, we can measure the moment that matters' standfirst, 5–6 sentence summary
Pattern sections (1 per pattern, 1–2 pages each): pattern statement, evidence across categories, strategic implication
Limitations section
What's next (Phase 2/3/4 roadmap)
Footer page: byline_long, methodology disclaimer, citation, datasets, contact
cross_category_report.logo_use: Product lockup (THIRDSYSTEM_AIPT_Logo.svg) on cover. Wordmark (THIRDSYSTEM_Logo.svg) in running header from page 2.
cross_category_report.chart_size_default: 3-col span (265pt / 3.68") for inline charts; 6-col span (540pt / 7.5") for full-width hero charts
cross_category_report.image_handling: All photo placeholders in template MUST be either left empty or filled with appropriate imagery — DO NOT render placeholder green/gray as design fills. For v0.6 redesign, no photography needed; replace placeholder rectangles with data visualizations or leave as whitespace.

hero_p4_country.purpose: Olive Oil + Skincare country-of-origin small multiples

inline_p1_variance.position: Pattern 1 section — inline alongside body text
inline_p1_variance.purpose: Per-model variance for top brands across categories

inline_p3_awareness_gap.purpose: AI Presence vs consumer awareness divergence

inline_p5_default_reinforcement.purpose: Default Reinforcement intensity across discourse-prompt alignment

category_snapshot.status: NEW — produce a template, then one per published category
category_snapshot.purpose: 2-page lead-gen artifact. One headline finding, the leaderboard, one chart, footer with CTA. Designed to be shared on LinkedIn or attached to outreach emails.
category_snapshot.audience: Cold-outreach prospects, LinkedIn audience, conference attendees.
category_snapshot.preferred_master: A-Snapshot - Front - 2 Columns - Letter - Portrait + B-Snapshot - Back - Letter - Portrait

Back: 'What this means for marketers' (3 short paragraphs), 'See your own exposure' soft CTA, contact block
category_snapshot.logo_use: Wordmark on front, product lockup on back
category_snapshot.chart_size_default: 3-col span (front), 6-col span if it's the hero
category_snapshot.cta: Curiosity-driven, not commercial. Sample: 'Want to know how your brand performs in AI mediation?' → hello@thirdsystem.ai

about_third_system_one_pager.name: About Third System
about_third_system_one_pager.purpose: Standalone explainer attached to every cold email and outreach message. Answers: what is this practice, who runs it, what does it measure, why does it matter, what's available.
about_third_system_one_pager.audience: Anyone who's asked 'wait, what is Third System?'
structure: Header: product lockup, tagline_primary
Block 1 (33%): What it is — descriptions.medium_100w
Block 2 (33%): What it measures — naming_hierarchy explained in plain language, the six AIAS components
Block 3 (33%): Who runs it — byline_long, brief credibility line (Sharp / Wharton / SVA references)
Footer: contact, web, citation example

methodology_brief.status: NEW — source content from methodology.md (when finalized; for now, draft from v06 limitations + 'what's next' sections)
methodology_brief.name: Methodology Brief
methodology_brief.purpose: Authority artifact. Folded tri-fold, distributable at SVA, conferences, in client meetings. Establishes that Third System has a real methodology.
methodology_brief.audience: Academic peers, brand strategy practitioners, clients evaluating credibility.
methodology_brief.preferred_master: E-Tri-Fold - Exterior - Letter + E-Tri-Fold - Interior - Letter
structure: Panel 1 (cover): product lockup, methodology version, tagline_primary
Panel 2: The three systems framework (mental + physical + AI availability), Sharp anchor
Panel 3: The six AIAS components (one short paragraph each)
Panel 4: Measurement protocol (CEPs, prompts, registry construction)
Panel 5: Limitations + roadmap (Phase 2/3/4)
Panel 6 (back): byline_long, citation, datasets URL, contact
methodology_brief.logo_use: Product lockup on cover, wordmark in interior
methodology_brief.fold_orientation: standard tri-fold (left flap → right flap → spread)

brand_diagnostic_report.purpose: The $10–15K paid pilot deliverable. Same look and structure as Cross-Category Report but scoped to one client's category and competitive set.
brand_diagnostic_report.audience: Paying client (CMO, brand director, head of brand strategy).
brand_diagnostic_report.preferred_master: C-Brochure - Cover - Option 1 (custom-cover) + C-Brochure - Product - AB - Letter
structure: Cover: client name, category, version, byline, CONFIDENTIAL marker
Executive summary (1 page): 3 key findings, what to do about them
Category context (1–2 pages): competitive set, registry, prompt design
Findings (4–8 pages): per-pattern analysis specific to the client's position
Implications (2 pages): directional recommendations
Methodology + caveats
Appendix: full leaderboard, datasets reference
brand_diagnostic_report.logo_use: Wordmark only (not the AIPT lockup) — keeps the focus on the client's situation, not on Third System's product
brand_diagnostic_report.delivery_mode: PDF only, watermarked with client name
